scene_spec.source: hand-designed kitchen counter: the coaster sits just behind the kettle as seen from the robot, so placing the cup there first drives the 20 cm-long gripper body onto the kettle

fixed_plan.diagnosis: The gripper body hit the kettle while lowering the cup; move the kettle first.

plan.diagnosis: Attempt 1 failed during vertical lower of cup onto coaster, not transit. Kettle is 0.25m tall and centered at [0.565,0.06] only 15.5cm west of coaster center [0.72,0.06], leaving ~8cm from coaster center to kettle side. Gripper body extends ~7.5cm laterally, evidenced by TCP at [0.715,0.061,0.211] while hand pressed kettle top at [0.64,0.06,0.25] with 119N. To place 0.1m cup on 0.01m coaster the tip must descend to ~0.11m, so the hand must descend into the kettle volume when centered over coaster. No via or transit_height can avoid this vertical descent collision. Correction is to clear the obstruction first: move kettle to trivet first, then place cup on now-isolated coaster. Final state still satisfies both on-goals.
